rule: These are public calls for work or evidence. They are not job offers, revenue, or verified demand. Status OPEN means the silo still wants it; DONE means shipped on the public surface.

calls.title: Wire NZBN verification service credentials
calls.summary: Supabase verify-nzbn returns SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED (missing NZBN_API_KEY and FOSSIL_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK). Frontend and Truth Oracle claim integration are ready; live register evidence needs keys.
acceptance: Successful lookup for a known 13-digit NZBN returns entity fields from the official register path
Signed packet or hash fields present when fossil key is configured
Failure modes still label unknown rather than inventing status

Export or copy of checklist state
Does not invent prices or treat blank as zero
